_doc: Render massing for the Karmelietenklooster (Aalbeeksesteenweg 13, south of the Damiaankerk), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1739207 (61.9 x 49.2 m around a courtyard) rendered as a flat 14 m block with a coral flat roof. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (footprint centre), u along 'axis_deg' 168.1 (u towards west-north-west), v towards south-south-west. Wings from the DHMV II grid (ridges 13-16 m, the low corridor along the church 5-9 m) and the 2024 orthophoto: brick wings with red pantile gable roofs around the cloister garth. The scattered DSM in the garden south of the long wing is trees, not building.

parts.id: long wing south of the cloister
